name: Yamaha Tenere 700
engine: 689 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected
intro: Yamaha's off-road-ready adventure twin, built on the MT-07 engine. Check two do-not-ride recalls.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls first
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Some 2022 Tenere 700s are in recall 23V472 for front brake caliper bolts, and 2025 bikes are in recall 26V367 for the turn signals. Both carry a do-not-ride advisory until repaired.
A-002.reason: The 2022 caliper can detach and cost you the front brake.

E: Check the subframe and crash bar mounts for cracks after any off-road drop.

recalls.what: Front brake caliper bolts may be the wrong length and the caliper can detach.
recalls.fix: Dealer inspects and replaces the bolts free.

recalls.what: Turn signals may fail. Do not ride until repaired.
